title: Communications Officer (Maternity Cover)
description:
About Global Canopy

Global Canopy is a data-driven not for profit delivering real transparency and accountability for market impacts on nature and people. Our special focus is on ending deforestation - an essential step in achieving urgent global goals on climate, nature and human rights.

Our platforms, data and insights are relied upon by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, national and regional governments, and some of the most effective campaigning organisations worldwide.

We work globally, with a focus on both forested regions (particularly across Latin America and South East Asia), and major consumer and financial markets (with a focus on Europe, the US, Singapore and China).

About Corporate Performance

A growing number of companies and financial institutions are seeking to mitigate their impacts on nature. But many have made commitments that are not being met, and others are failing to take any action at all.

We hold the most exposed companies and financial institutions to account through our Forest 500 project, by assessing their policies and performance.

With our suite of Deforestation-free Finance Guidance and a forthcoming new tool, DEFT Pathway, we provide tools and data for financial institutions and investors to support effective engagement with high-risk companies. We support the finance sector, policy makers and other stakeholders by providing market-leading data on deforestation and ESG metrics through Forest IQ.

About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity for an individual with experience in communications and/or marketing to become part of an accomplished and proactive team at the heart of the fight against market-driven deforestation and nature loss.

The Communications Officer will support the Communications Lead to deliver communications activity across the Corporate Performance programme, with responsibility for the day-to-day delivery and coordination of digital communications, including website content, newsletters, social media, webinars and media monitoring.

The role will work closely with programme colleagues, subject-matter experts and the wider Communications team to develop accurate, engaging and audience-focused content, and to ensure communications activity is delivered effectively, consistently and on time.

Finally - as we ask of all colleagues - you will contribute to a culture of kindness, collaboration, rigour and accountability in equal measure. You will share our conviction that it is not just what we do that matters in our working life, but how we do it too.

Ideally the successful candidate will be available to start in the first week of December.

Responsibilities
- Manage and publish content across Global Canopy's websites, keeping content accurate, up to date, accessible and aligned with programme and organisational objectives.
- Coordinate and deliver newsletters and email communications, including drafting, building and sending Mailchimp campaigns, advising on email tactics and best practice, and monitoring campaign performance.
- Draft, edit and proofread communications content, including website copy, newsletter content, social media copy, webinar materials and other digital communications, working with subject-matter experts to translate technical information into clear and engaging content.
- Coordinate and support external Communications webinars, including publicity, invitations, communications materials, technical hosting, moderator and housekeeping materials, liaison with speakers and interpreters, and preparation and publication of webinar recordings.
- Monitor relevant communications, digital and sustainability trends and the external news landscape, identifying opportunities and recommending approaches that could strengthen Global Canopy's communications.
- Support social media communications, including drafting copy, creating social share kits and maintaining communications resources, in collaboration with Communications Leads and the Digital Communications Designer.
- Conduct monthly and quarterly monitoring across media coverage, webinar engagement and Mailchimp analytics - maintaining media records, evaluating coverage and actively contributing as part of the Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) working group.
- Support the management of journalist lists, undertaking research for media outreach, and logging and evaluating media coverage.
- Maintain communications resources, including relevant website content and image banks, ensuring content is well organised and consistent with Global Canopy's brand.
- Work collaboratively across the Communications and programme teams, providing communications support and expertise as required.

About You

To be successful in this role, these are the things that will matter the most:
- Strong editorial judgement and a good eye for design and visual presentation
- Excellent writing, editing and proofreading skills, with the ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, accurate and engaging content tailored for specific audiences
- Strong organisational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities.
- Good understanding of digital communications and social media

Essential behavioural competencies:
- Good interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships with colleagues across different teams
- Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage day-to-day communications activity while knowing when to seek advice or approval
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

Skills and experience:
- At least three years' experience working in a communications, marketing, digital communications or related role or equivalent experience
- Experience working with technical or complex subject matter and translating it for non-specialist audiences.
- Experience managing and publishing content through a website content management system and using email marketing platforms such as Mailchimp
- Experience supporting webinars, online events or other external-facing events

Desirable
- Interest in how data can illuminate stories and change minds
- Knowledge of the external news and media landscape, especially on sustainability, deforestation and the finance sector
- Experience and/or interest in working with a global team
- Knowledge of languages spoken in forest-rich regions (e.g. Brazilian Portuguese, Bahasa Indonesia, Spanish, French)

Salary & Benefits

Salary: £33,000 full time equivalent. This role sits within Band E on Global Canopy's remuneration framework.

Nature of contract: Full-time, 14-month maternity cover. Our office is in Oxford, with flexible home-working arrangements in place. Attendance at the office would be required once a month at minimum, with additional attendance for Corporate Performance quarterly meetings.

Holidays: 36 days (including bank/public holidays) for discretionary use across the annual leave year. Option to purchase up to an additional 5 days or equivalent of one week's leave.

Pension: Employer pension contribution of 8%.

Healthcare cashback plan: Covering dental fees, eye-care, wellbeing, physiotherapy, chiropody and much more - for you and any children.

Employee Assistance Programme: Which provides free, confidential advice on personal and legal matters.

Other: Huge range of discounts and cashback deals at gyms, restaurants, holidays, and much more.

How to Apply

To apply for the position, please use follow the link below and submit an up-to date CV and a cover letter explaining your interest in and suitability for the role (please no more than one side of A4).

The closing date for applications is Tuesday, 29 September at 9am BST. Early application encouraged. We may close applications early if enough suitable candidates are identified.

The recruitment process for this position is intended to be as follows:

1. First-round interview of 30 mins (to be held 5-7 Oct)

2. Written assessment to complete in your own time

3. Final interview of 1 hour (to be held 20 & 21 Oct)

Applicants are required to disclose if and how they have used AI in their application. Right-to-work in the UK is required for this position.

This recruitment process will take place online via video. The entire process is likely to take 4 weeks to complete from the closing date of this advert. Due to the volume of interest, we are unable to provide all applicants with individual feedback.

title: Content Creator
description:
Are you a creative visual storyteller with a passion for capturing authentic moments? Abingdon School has an exciting Content Creator opportunity!

Location: Park Road, Abingdon, Oxfordshire, OX14 1 DE

Salary: £30,393 to £33,504 per annum

Job Type: Permanent, Full-time

Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday (08:30 to 17:00, with 30 minutes unpaid lunch)

Closing Date: 23 September 2026 (9am)

About Us:

The Foundation comprises two schools: Abingdon School and Abingdon Prep School, as well as Abingdon School Enterprises. Abingdon School is a leading independent day and boarding school with more than 1,000 pupils aged 11-18. Currently a boys' school, it will become co-educational from September 2026.

Abingdon Prep School is a vibrant and warm day preparatory school with around 200 pupils aged 4-13 which has been co-educational since last year. Both Schools are situated in beautiful and extensive grounds, with the senior school in the heart of Abingdon on Thames, just south of Oxford, and the Prep School located a few miles away in nearby Frilford.

Content Creator - The Role:

This is a hands-on creative role working closely with the marketing team across the Group. You will capture and edit high-quality photography and video footage, design marketing collateral, and produce visually strong, engaging content for different audiences. You will balance immediacy with quality, sometimes posting live during events while also creating considered campaign content. The role requires flexibility, including occasional evenings and weekends to cover priority events and activities, with off-site work at various Group locations and external venues.

Content Creator - Key Responsibilities:
- Capture high-quality photography and video of day-to-day activities, planned campaigns and spontaneous community moments across all Group settings
- Produce platform-ready content including reels, stories, short-form videos, hero images and campaign assets, adapting formats for different channels
- Collaborate with Marketing Managers to plan storytelling aligned with key content pillars and brand values
- Post live to social media during priority events and write short-form copy including captions, calls to action and hashtags
- Organise and archive assets using agreed naming conventions, enabling fast retrieval and re-use
- Support live or near-live event coverage including basic live streaming where required
- Maintain kit readiness, production standards and compliance with consent, safeguarding and data protection procedures

Content Creator - You:
- Strong photography and video editing skills with experience using professional software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or similar
- A creative eye for visual storytelling, composition and current digital and social media trends
- Confident using both smartphone and camera kit with basic lighting and audio awareness
- Excellent organisational skills and ability to produce consistently high-quality content to tight deadlines
- Experience writing short social media copy and longer-form website content for different audiences and contexts
- Professional, approachable, reliable and adaptable with strong judgement about tone, audience and safeguarding in a school environment

Benefits:
- You'll get 25 days off paid time off each year plus bank holidays
- Up to 14.1% employer pension contribution
- Abingdon Foundation Death in Service Scheme
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Private healthcare insurance
- We may be able to offer flexible working from home
- Free use of leisure facilities with discounted exercise classes
- Free lunches during term time
- Cycle to work scheme
- Christmas closure days
- Discounted school fees (eligibility criteria apply)
- There are regular staff social events and opportunities to join other staff
- We offer free on-site parking and bike storage for all staff
- We offer a range of online and in-person courses to staff for free including first aid, mental health first aid and health and safety courses

Closing Date: 23 September 2026 (9am)

Interviews: 30 September or 01 October 2026

We recognise the value of a diverse and inclusive workplace and are committed to equality of

opportunity for all staff and job applicants.

Early applications are encouraged. We may make an appointment prior to the advertised closing or interview dates.

Abingdon is committed to safeguarding the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment. All appointments are subject to a satisfactory enhanced DBS check.

To submit your CV for this exciting Content Creator opportunity, click Apply today!

title: Digital Marketing Executive

title: Email Campaign Executive
description:
Ready to make your mark in digital marketing?

If you love getting stuck into email campaigns, spotting what makes a subject line work, and turning data into decisions, this could be your next big move.

An exciting opportunity has opened up for an Email Campaign Executive to join a well-established manufacturer in the safety equipment sector, based in Oxfordshire. This is a genuinely international business, and this role puts you right at the centre of how they communicate with their global distribution network.

You'll take ownership of email marketing campaigns from planning through to reporting, working closely with Product, Sales and Marketing teams across multiple regions. It's a role with real variety, real responsibility, and real opportunity to grow.

On offer is a salary of £27,000 plus a bonus of up to £2,000 a year, paid quarterly based on sales targets. You'll also get 25 days holiday, an employer-matched pension, a personal development plan, Perkbox discounts, a wellbeing programme, and a cycle-to-work scheme. The role is office-based (with WFH one day a week once you're through probation), so you'll need your own transport to get there.

Key Responsibilities:
- Plan, build and send email campaigns for the company's global distribution network
- Manage a global campaign calendar so every send lands on time
- Build targeted campaigns around customer needs and business goals
- Create and manage automated journeys, nurture campaigns and lead generation
- Work closely with Product, Sales and Marketing teams across different regions
- Keep the marketing database clean and GDPR-compliant
- Run A/B tests to keep improving campaign performance
- Track KPIs and turn the numbers into clear, actionable insight
- Make sure every campaign matches company brand guidelines and technical accuracy
- Support event promotion and follow-up lead nurturing
- Spot opportunities to improve automation, reporting and campaign efficiency

Skills & Experience:
- 2+ years' experience in email marketing, campaign management or marketing automation
- Experience in a B2 B marketing environment
- Confident with CRM systems and customer data
- Hands-on experience with email marketing platforms and automation tools
- Comfortable analysing performance data and turning it into recommendations
- Experience building campaign reports and dashboards
- Sharp attention to detail and solid project management skills
- Strong written communication and copywriting ability
- Able to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines at once
- A team player who's used to working across marketing, sales and product
- Bonus points for experience with international markets or multi-language campaigns

How to Apply:

This is a genuine chance to grow your marketing career inside an established, international manufacturer, with training, support and real ownership from day one. If you're re ady to take the next step, apply now or contact Niche Recruitment with any questions.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Oxfordshire

£30-40k

VR/10568

A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a skilled Marketing Executive to join a successful and well-established company based in Oxfordshire, who are part of a large international group. They are now embarking on an exciting phase of growth and this is a new role to help increase their impact and reach.

This role is perfect for an all round marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys building from the ground up.

Reporting to the Marketing Manager, the Marketing Executive will primarily focus on D2 C and B2 B funnels optimisation. Your work will directly contribute to brand awareness, lead generation, and revenue growth.

Your role will involve:
- Brand - Keep consistency within the company's core brand values, tone, and visual identity across all customer-facing assets (website, social media, email, print, etc.).
- Campaigns and Email Marketing - Develop, execute, and optimise multi-channel campaigns (email, social, paid, organic) to drive conversion.
- A/B test subject lines, CTAs, and content to refine performance.
- SEO, Content and Design - Create and optimise landing pages, blog posts,and marketing collateral.
- Conduct keyword research and implement on-page SEO best practices (meta tags, headers, internal linking) to improve organic search rankings.
- Design on marketing materials (social posts,brochures, presentations) using brand guidelines
- Social media - Manage and grow the company's presence on LinkedIn (B2 B) and Instagram (D2 C and B2 B), tailoring content for each audience.
- Events - Coordinate with event partners to ensure seamless execution of conferences and planned activities
- CRM - Maintain data hygiene in the CRM (e.g., deduplication, missing information, tagging)
- Performance Marketing - Collect, visualise, and interpret performance data to inform decisions.

You will be the ideal candidate due to your:
- Previous marketing experience in B2 C and/or B2 B.
- Marketing generalist mindset: Comfortable wearing multiple hats and adapting to evolving priorities
- Strong content marketing and storytelling skills: Ability to craft SEO-optimised narratives for diverse audiences.
- Data-driven decision-making: Proficient in analysing metrics (GA4, CRM reports and more) to optimise campaigns.
- Proactive and autonomous.
- Growth mindset: Curious, resourceful, and always seeking to learn and improve.
- Hands-on CRM experience.

Desirable
- HubSpot knowledge and/or certification
- Canva or designing tools (Adobe Suite, Figma)
- Brevo or other email marketing tools
- E-commerce platform i.e Shopify
- SEO/SEM knowledge: Basic understanding of technical SEO, backlinking, and paid search strategies
- Project Management: Ability to juggle multiple deadlines.
